# Moonfin 3.0.0 Release Notes [![github](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/Moonfin-Client/Moonfin-Core/3.0.0/total?logo=github&label=Downloads)](https://github.com/Moonfin-Client/Moonfin-Core/releases/tag/3.0.0)

## 3.0.0 ALREADY?? What changed?

### Nothing changed really. This update was bigger than I honestly thought it and it should have been marked as 3.0. Also now that all Moonfin clients are equal in terms of features, functionality, and UI, this gives me a change to have all clients and the plugin on the same release numbers and release schedule. I apologize for any confusion and annoyance. 

## The same release notes as 2.8.0 are below:

Moonfin 3.0.0 is a big one, with about 750 commits since 2.7.0 and a whole UI refresh.

Moonfin can now sign in to Plex. On desktop, a new mini player keeps your video going while you browse. Every player can show two subtitles at once, and servers that require a client certificate work now. The music player, the EPUB reader and the admin panel were all rebuilt, and the admin panel works on Emby too. Libraries come in new styles, Live TV can rewind, Apple devices play Dolby Vision Profile 7 FEL, and game libraries can link a RomM account.

There are plenty of fixes too. The server no longer re-encodes 4K HDR just because the audio needs converting. Bitstreamed audio survives a refresh rate switch on Android TV, and artwork keeps loading after a few missing images.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Moonfin 3.0.0 needs iOS or iPadOS 18, tvOS 18 or macOS 15 Sequoia. Devices on iOS 16 or 17, tvOS 17 or macOS 14 Sonoma can't install it and will stay on 2.7.0.

> [!NOTE]
> Update the server plugin to [v3.0.0](https://github.com/Moonfin-Client/Plugin/releases/tag/3.0.0) too. It syncs most of the new settings between your devices, like library styles, keyboard style, backdrops, ratings and the new subtitle preferences. Anything marked *(Moonbase)* below needs it, along with the features whose bullets mention the plugin.

## Features

### Plex

- **Sign in with Plex.** Choose Sign in with Plex in Add Server. Then enter the four-character code at plex.tv/link, scan the QR code on TV or open the page right from your phone or desktop. Your Plex email or username and password work too, two-step verification included. Typing a Plex server's address, or picking one found on your network, also takes you to Plex sign-in.
- **Plex Home users.** Your Plex Home members show up on the server's user screen, and each one signs in with their own access to the server. Members with a PIN are checked against plex.tv.
- **The best address, every time.** Each time Moonfin starts, it tries every address your server lists at once, local first and relays last. A relay picked at sign-in doesn't stick, so the connection follows you between home and away. If your router blocks plex.direct names, Moonfin falls back to the plain local address.
- **Browsing.** Home has Continue Watching, Next Up, Latest and Recently Released rows, and libraries have filters. Details pages show HDR, Dolby Vision and frame rate. You can search, browse people, genres and studios, and create and edit collections and playlists.
- **Playback.** Anything the device can decode plays directly. Everything else goes through Plex's HLS transcoder, with the same device limits Moonfin sends to Jellyfin and Emby. Every audio and subtitle format plays, resume points and watched state sync, and if Plex refuses a stream you'll see its reason on screen. Skip intro and credits, chapter images, seek bar previews, multi-part movies, trailers and extras, series theme songs and Cinema Mode's trailers and pre-roll all come from Plex.
- **Music.** Artist and album pages are in the right order, and lyrics come from .lrc files and LyricFind. Instant Mix uses Plex's sonic analysis when your server has it, and matching genres when it doesn't.
- **Live TV and DVR.** The guide and playback cover your server's tuners and Plex's free channels. You can

Moonfin

Premium Jellyfin, Emby, Plex & Silo client for mobile, tablet, desktop, TV, and web

---

[![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/Moonfin-Client/Moonfin-Core.svg)](LICENSE) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Moonfin-Client/Moonfin-Core)](https://github.com/Moonfin-Client/Moonfin-Core/releases) [![Github Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/Moonfin-Client/Moonfin-Core/total?label=Downloads)](https://github.com/Moonfin-Client/Moonfin-Core/releases) [![Google Play Downloads](https://playbadges.pavi2410.com/badge/downloads?id=org.moonfin.androidtv&pretty)](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=org.moonfin.androidtv) [![BuyMeACoffee](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pachadotdev/buymeacoffee-badges/main/bmc-yellow.svg)](https://www.buymeacoffee.com/moonfin) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-Join%20Us-5865F2?logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/moonfin) > **[← Back to main Moonfin project](https://github.com/Moonfin-Client)** Moonfin is a media client for Jellyfin, Emby, Plex and Silo servers, built with Flutter. One shared codebase powers phones and tablets, Windows, macOS, and Linux, Android TV, Fire TV, and Apple TV, and the browser. It's made for people who want a modern, customizable experience on every screen they own. ## Where to get it | Platform | Download | | ------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Android Mobile / TV | [![Google Play](https://img.shields.io/badge/Google%20Play-grey?logo=Google+Play\&label=)](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=org.moonfin.androidtv) | | Fire TV | [![Amazon Appstore](https://img.shields.io/badge/Amazon%20Appstore-FF9900?logo=amazon\&logoColor=white)](https://www.amazon.com/Moonfin/dp/B0H76BG3DW) | | iOS | [![App Store](https://img.shields.io/badge/App_Store-0D96F6?logo=app-store\&logoColor=white)](https://apps.apple.com/app/moonfin/id6761283970) | | Linux | [![Arch Linux](https://img.shields.io/badge/Arch%20Linux-1793D1?logo=arch-linux\&logoColor=fff)](https://aur.archlinux.org/packages/moonfin-bin)

or `winget install Moonfin.Moonfin` | | ## Supported Servers | Server | Minimum Version | Status | |--------|------------------|--------| | Jellyfin | 10.8.0+ | Full support | | Emby | 4.8.0.0+ | Full support (the admin panel needs 4.9+) | | Plex | Plex Media Server 1.43+ | Supported. Moonbase features need the [Moonbase for Plex](https://github.com/Moonfin-Client/Plugin/blob/master/Go/README.md) companion | | [Silo](https://github.com/Silo-Server/silo-server) | API v2 (`api_major` 2) | Supported through Silo's native API, see below | ### Silo Moonfin talks to Silo through its native API (`/api/v2`), not its Jellyfin-compatible service. Add the server by its native address, which is port 8090 with Silo's Docker Compose setup or 8080 without Docker. If you enter the Jellyfin-compatible address on port 8096, Moonfin offers to connect to Silo directly, or you can keep it as a Jellyfin server. Silo servers on your local network also show up under Discovered Servers, except on web. Sign-in with a password or a code, Home, libraries, search, favorites, watched state, ratings, collections, playback, skip intro and credits, trickplay, household profiles with their PINs, and downloads with offline progress sync all work. Requests use Silo's own requests feature in place of Seerr, and Watch Parties use Silo's own watch party rooms. Settings sync, admin defaults, server messages, custom themes and MDBList and TMDB ratings need [Moonbase](https://github.com/Moonfin-Client/Plugin) for Silo, installed from Plugins > Catalog in Silo's admin pages. Live TV and DVR, music, playlists, remote control of other devices, the server admin panel (Silo's is in its web app) and retro games aren't available on Silo, so Moonfin hides them while a Silo server is active. Books, audiobooks, 4K requests and Silo's server-side download subscriptions aren't supported yet. If a Silo server has a newer API than your version of Moonfin, Moonfin won't connect to it and asks you to update Moonfin. ## Platform Support | Platform | Minimum Version | Status | |----------|------------------|--------| | **Android** | 7.0 (API 24) | Full support | | **Android TV / Google TV** | Android 7.0 (API 24) | Full support | | **Fire TV** | Fire OS 6 | Full support | | **iOS** | 18.0 | Full support | | **Apple TV (tvOS)** | 18.0 | Full support | | **macOS** | 15.0 (Sequoia) | Full support | | **Windows** | 10 (x64 and ARM64) | Full support | | **Linux** | GTK 3+, CMake 3.13+ | Full support (Wayland and X11) | | **Web** | Modern browsers (installable PWA) | Full support | > Android TV, Fire TV, and Apple TV ship from this same codebase with a TV-tuned interface and D-pad navigation. Fire TV runs the same native backend as Android TV. Web runs as an installable PWA through the Moonbase server plugin. ## Features - **One codebase, every screen.** Phones, tablets, desktop, Android TV, Apple TV, and web, with navigation tuned for touch, pointer, and remote. - **Playback that just works.** Wide codec support including AV1, HEVC, Dolby Vision, Dolby Atmos, HDR10+, and audio passthrough. Dolby Vision Profile 7 direct plays on Apple and Android TV, converted in real time instead of transcoded, with most of a FEL file's enhancement layer kept on Apple devices, and Windows can send HDR to the display untouched. Two subtitle tracks can show at once on every player. See [Playback and Codecs](https://github.com/Moonfin-Client/Moonfin-Core/wiki/Playback-and-Codecs). - **A mini player on desktop** that keeps the video playing in a bar along the bottom while you browse. - **Offline downloads** in original or smaller server-transcoded quality, with automatic folder organization, offline subtitles, automatic downloads of new episodes for the series you follow, and Smart downloads on phones and tablets that keep the next episodes of a show downloaded and clear them once watched. See [Downloads](https://github.com/Moonfin-Client/Moonfin-Core/wiki/Downloads). - **Ebooks and audiobooks.** Read EPUB, MOBI, AZW/AZW3, PDF, and comic archives, with your reading progress synced to the server. Play M4B audiobooks with chapter navigation. - **Retro games** browsed and played in-app from a server game library, with gamepad support, save states and battery saves that sync between devices, hardware rendering on Android, and RomM-backed libraries you browse with your own RomM account. See [Retro Games](https://github.com/Moonfin-Client/Moonfin-Core/wiki/Retro-Games). - **Multi-server unified library** that merges several Jellyfin and Emby servers into one browsable, searchable UI. - **Library styles** for video, music, and book libraries, from the classic grid to a docked side panel, an immersive music hero, or a bookstore shelf. - **A setup wizard on first run** that asks how you want the app to look, with live previews built from your own artwork, and a Settings screen that previews each change live. - **Nine detail screen styles** to pick from: Classic, Modern, Spotlight, Nouveau, Minimalist, Stage, Premiere, Quick Look, and Frost. - **Featured media bar** with six layouts, plus optional in-bar trailer previews. - **Themes and a Theme Store** with a built-in editor, server-side sync, and an OLED mode for true blacks, plus custom loading animations and a screensaver on TV. - **An integrated admin panel** for Jellyfin and Emby, covering settings, users, libraries, Live TV, logs, devices, and analytics, plus a messages window for notes from your server admin. - **Discovery with Seerr** built into the details screen, with trending, popular, and upcoming rows and request status overlays. - **Smart Search** that finds titles from a plain sentence, **poster labels** like 4K and HDR, and a **Calendar** of what's coming up in Sonarr and Radarr with reminders on phones and tablets, all served by the Moonbase plugin. - **Live TV and DVR** with a program guide, rewind on channels that keep a rewind window, a quick channel changer on TV, automatic recovery when a channel stalls, and recording management. - **Client certificates (mTLS)** for servers that require one, with a page you open on your phone to send the certificate to a TV. - **Trickplay scrubbing** as a single thumbnail, a filmstrip, or full screen, on both Jellyfin and Emby. - **Cinema Mode and segment skipping** for pre-rolls, intros, credits, and SponsorBlock. - **Casting and remote control** over Google Cast, DLNA, and AirPlay, plus control of other Jellyfin devices on your network with a D-pad and search typed from your phone. Other Jellyfin apps can steer Moonfin too. - **Watch Parties** with chat, reactions, invite links, and voting on what to watch. Moonbase hosts them on Jellyfin, Emby, and Plex, Silo hosts its own, and SyncPlay is still there on Jellyfin. - **Personal ratings** as a like, five stars, or a score out of ten, usable to sort or filter a library. - **Kids Mode** that strips the app back to what a child needs and locks the way out with a PIN, plus blocked ratings that apply everywhere in the app. - **Achievement Badges** drawn natively when your Jellyfin server runs the Achievement Badges plugin, including its friends list and chat. - **Anime markers** for filler, recap, canon, and subbed or dubbed episodes, served by the Moonbase plugin. - **Ratings from MDBList and TMDB**, home row customization with a seasonal holiday row, and in-app update checks. The full list is on the [Features](https://github.com/Moonfin-Client/Moonfin-Core/wiki/Features) wiki page. ## Screenshots ### TV and desktop

### Mobile

## Installation The store links above are the easy route. To install a file yourself, download it from the [Releases page](https://github.com/Moonfin-Client/Moonfin-Core/releases) and pick the one for your device: | Platform | File | |---|---| | Android (phones and tablets) | `Moonfin_Android_v.apk` | | Android TV / Google TV / Fire TV | `Moonfin_AndroidTV_v.apk` | | iOS | `Moonfin_iOS_v_unsigned.ipa` (for self-signing) | | Apple TV | `Moonfin_tvOS_v_unsigned.ipa` (for self-signing) | | Windows x64 | `Moonfin_Windows_v.exe` | | Windows ARM64 | `Moonfin_WindowsARM64_v.exe` | | macOS | `Moonfin_macOS_v.dmg` | | Linux x64 | `Moonfin_Linux_v.` (AppImage, deb, rpm, snap, flatpak, tarball) | | Linux ARM64 | `Moonfin_LinuxARM64_v.` (same formats) | | Web | Served as a PWA by the [Moonbase](https://github.com/Moonfin-Client/Plugin) server plugin, no download needed | On Arch Linux, install from the AUR with `yay -S moonfin-bin` (or `paru -S moonfin-bin`, `pamac build moonfin-bin`). Click-by-click steps for every platform are on [Installation](https://github.com/Moonfin-Client/Moonfin-Core/wiki/Installation), and [Getting Started](https://github.com/Moonfin-Client/Moonfin-Core/wiki/Getting-Started) covers connecting to your server for the first time. ## Building Flutter stable 3.47 or newer is the one thing every platform needs (Dart 3.13 comes with it). Each target also needs its own toolchain: Android Studio with the SDK and NDK for Android, Xcode and CocoaPods for iOS and macOS, the flutter-tvos toolchain for Apple TV, Visual Studio and vcpkg for Windows, and a handful of development packages on Linux. Every Android command also takes a `--flavor`. ```bash git clone https://github.com/Moonfin-Client/Moonfin-Core.git cd Moonfin-Core flutter pub get ``` The per-platform build commands are on [Building from Source](https://github.com/Moonfin-Client/Moonfin-Core/wiki/Building-from-Source). ## Documentation The deeper reference material lives in the feature list, section by section | | [Playback and Codecs](https://github.com/Moonfin-Client/Moonfin-Core/wiki/Playback-and-Codecs) | The backend per platform, the codec table, HDR, and audio downloads, subtitle downloads, themes, parental controls, and Kids Mode | | [Common Problems](https://github.com/Moonfin-Client/Moonfin-Core/wiki/Common-Problems) | Plain fixes for connection, login, playback, sound, subtitle, download and casting trouble | | [Collecting Logs](https://github.com/Moonfin-Client/Moonfin-Core/wiki/Collecting-Logs) | Capturing a diagnostic report for a bug report | | from Source](https://github.com/Moonfin-Client/Moonfin-Core/wiki/Building-from-Source) | Toolchain versions, step by step setup, and the build commands for every platform | | [Development](https://github.com/Moonfin-Client/Moonfin-Core/wiki/Development) | Developer notes, contributing guidelines, and the pull request process | ## Contributing Contributions are welcome. Check the existing issues first, discuss major feature changes before implementing them, match the existing code style, run `flutter analyze`, and test on at least one target platform. Keep pull requests focused and include context, screenshots or logs where useful. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for the full guidelines and the pull request process. ## Help translate Moonfin [here](https://translate.moonfin.io/projects/moonfin/moonfin-core/) ## Support and Community - **Issues**: [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Moonfin-Client/Moonfin-Core/issues) - **Discussions**: [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/Moonfin-Client/Moonfin-Core/discussions) - **Discord**: [Discord](https://discord.gg/moonfin) - **Upstream Jellyfin**: [jellyfin.org](https://jellyfin.org) ## Credits Moonfin is built on the work of: - **[Jellyfin Project](https://jellyfin.org)** - **Jellyfin client contributors** - **Moonfin contributors** - **[MakD](https://github.com/MakD)** - Original Jellyfin-Media-Bar concept that inspired our featured media bar - **[MediaLyze](https://github.com/frederikemmer/MediaLyze)** The Admin analytics UI was inspired by this open-source project ## License Moonfin is free software.
